brightness.bin.description: A well-formed BRIGHTNESS command set to 128.

malformed_header.bin.description: A message whose magic byte is 0xFF instead of 0xA5; must be rejected before the header is otherwise trusted.

truncated_frame.bin.description: A FRAME header declaring the full 8206-byte payload, but only 100 bytes actually follow (e.g. a dropped TCP segment); must be detected as malformed, not read out of bounds.

unsupported_version.bin.description: A HELLO declaring protocol_version=99 in both the header and payload; server must reply STATUS(ERR_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION) and close.

valid_frame_64x64.bin.description: A well-formed 64x64 RGB565 FRAME with sequence=42.

valid_hello.bin.description: A well-formed HELLO from a 64x64 RGB565 device.
